remaining_risks: Direct CLI `dopemux mcp start --service task-orchestrator` does not acquire `instance_lock` (by design, to avoid nesting `instance_lock` with `reserved_port_lock(7890)`), so a concurrent `reap --apply` on a removed/idle worktree can remove `runtime_dir` after the orchestrator registry update; `skip_artifacts = not compose_services` (src/dopemux/mcp/lifecycle.py:710) prevents recreating `runtime_dir`, leaving at most a stale orchestrator registry entry (documented in design.md:304).
`dopemux mcp doctor --repo <target>` and `dopemux mcp profile show --repo <target>` still load the caller checkout's catalog when invoked from outside `<target>` (documented in design.md:305).

Interactive `dopemux mcp switch-project` without `--yes` performs an unlocked pre-check before prompting the operator and re-verifies ownership under `reserved_port_lock(7890)` before mutating state (src/dopemux/commands/mcp_commands.py:432-477, documented in design.md:306).
